senses.gloss: वाम् 1. vām, encl. ac., d., g., du. of the prn. 🞄of the second person.
वाम् 2. vā́m, perh. nm. du. = āvām (RV.¹).

वमि vam-i, f. (also ī) vomiting, nausea;
 🞄-itavya, fp. to be vomited or spit out.
वामी vām-ī́, f. female camel (only —˚ with 🞄uṣṭra-).
वम्र vam-rá, m., ī́, f. ant.

वामा vāmā, f. (of 1. vāma) lovely woman;
 🞄woman.
वामनयना vāma-nayanā, f. fair-eyed woman.
वामनाश्रम vāmana‿āśrama, m. N. of a hermitage.
वामनी vāma-nī, a. bringing wealth: -tva, 🞄n. attribute of bestowing wealth.

वामनीकृ vāmanī-kṛ, turn into a dwarf;
 🞄-bhū, become bent, bow oneself.

वामभ्रू vāma-bhrū, f. left eyebrow;
 (a.) f. 🞄fair-eyed woman.
वामलूर vāmalūra, m. ant-hill.
वामिन् vām-in, a. vomiting, ejecting.

वाम्य vām-ya, 〈1.〉 a. belonging to Vāma 🞄(-deva);
 〈2.〉 n. perverseness.
